description: Defines the ChannelScanTask class for managing WiFi channel scanning operations within the beerocks namespace, including handling scan requests, states, and results, as well as interactions with 1905.1 messages.

classes.name: ChannelScanTask
classes.description: Manages WiFi channel scanning, handling requests, states, and results, and communicates via 1905.1 messages within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: ChannelScanTask
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scan task with context, message, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Performs the main task processing logic.

methods.name: set_radio_scan_status
methods.description: Sets the status of individual channels in a scan.

methods.name: trigger_radio_scan
methods.description: Sends a trigger scan command to the monitor.

methods.name: store_radio_scan_result
methods.description: Stores scan results in the database.

methods.name: get_scan_results_for_request
methods.description: Retrieves stored scan results for a request.
